Dog and Vet – Ethical Pet Care by Dr. S.K. Mishra

Welcome to Dog and Vet – Ethical Pet Care by Dr. S.K. Mishra, a trusted YouTube channel dedicated to dog treatment, cat care, bird health, pet diet planning, behaviour training, home remedies, homeopathy, and veterinary advice in Hindi. This platform is created to provide scientific, practical, and ethical guidance to pet owners so they can make the right decisions for their animals during illness, emergencies, and daily care.

With over 18 plus years of clinical veterinary experience and a growing community of more than 2 lakh subscribers, this channel focuses on delivering real, experience-based knowledge rather than theoretical or misleading information. The goal is to help pet owners understand diseases, recognize early symptoms, and take timely action to improve the health and life of their pets.
